reason: The README clearly describes an Agent tool that converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into GitHub-Flavored Markdown, with optional local output-file writing.

summaries.zh: 将 Word、PPT、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 等文件转换为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。
summaries.en: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into GitHub-Flavored Markdown.

capabilities: Reads supported document files from local paths
Converts supported document formats to GitHub-Flavored Markdown
Optionally writes converted output to a local file
